reviewed_document: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md
summary: 身份与跨包 Coordinator/Planner 边界仍未达到可编译的具体合同；bundle 在 rollback、unknown commit、跨请求/重启恢复时没有可实现的持有生命周期。

previous_findings.evidence: Exported PilotStartCoordinator/private Store actor direction is added, but auth.Principal is absent in current code and Planner's verified context boundary remains undefined.
Current TeacherInput is used without a LessonOrdinal extension; server-side ordinal gates the new Agent method.
schema_version is specified as tool JSON Schema version; pilot-audit-map/v1 is a separate mapping protocol.
User.Nickname normalization is specified but auth.User and persistent store.User are distinct current sources.

findings.title: auth.Principal does not exist and current Claims is forgeable
findings.recommendation: Specify a new opaque verified principal returned by token verification, or explicitly accept verified Claims only from trusted middleware and recheck persisted student role/status in Store.

findings.title: Cross-package verified planning context and task capability flow are undefined
findings.recommendation: Freeze a compilable Store Coordinator/Planner contract using a minimal read-only opaque planning context and typed bundle; Store must validate principal and reservation before invoking Planner, while API cannot forge actor/task.

findings.title: Bundle has no defined holder or lifecycle across rollback, unknown commit, request loss and restart
findings.recommendation: Define generation point, owner, key, single-flight, TTL and crash/unknown behavior; never regenerate while outcome is unknown; post-restart without receipt/bundle must remain unresolved.

findings.title: Same-bundle re-entry after pending_unknown is not realizable through current request contract
findings.recommendation: Specify internal coordinator states and restrict retries to a retained opaque bundle after proven rollback; clients cannot submit arbitrary bundle.

findings.title: Nickname source and committed replay behavior are ambiguous
findings.recommendation: Choose persistent store.User.Nickname as source or define synchronization; after current owner authorization, a committed same-command receipt should remain retrievable if the profile nickname later changes.

findings.title: Tool execution relative to writer lock is unspecified
findings.recommendation: Choose before-writer or inside-writer execution and document replay races, transaction duration, and bundle retention semantics.

findings.title: Tool schema v1 bytes and strict extra-field enforcement are not frozen
findings.recommendation: Record exact say/show_word schema representation/hash and identify strict decoder that rejects unknown fields beyond Registry's schema subset.
